proof_roadmap: Geometric regularity of the factor (proof lines 12247-12260).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that geometric regularity of a formal fibre ascends along a quasi-finite map of Noetherian rings, and consequently that the G-ring property ascends along quasi-finite maps. The proof records the easy implications between the three statements, then at the relevant primes uses the product decomposition of the completion after base change along a quasi-finite map to express the target formal fibre as one factor of the base changed completion, and concludes geometric regularity of that factor from the hypothesis on the source formal fibre together with the geometric regularity of the other factor.
